summary: Completed comprehensive testing of admin login fix (DB-backed auth with bcrypt). All 8 requirements verified: new credentials work, case-insensitive email, wrong password handling, old credentials rejected, DB seeding with bcrypt hash, browser login/logout flows, session persistence, and no regressions in admin endpoints.
passed_tests: POST /api/admin/login with new credentials (dkmanjeshbelli@gmail.com / 9980577310@aB) returns 200 with token + email + role='admin' + httpOnly Set-Cookie
POST /api/admin/login with UPPERCASE email (DKMANJESHBELLI@GMAIL.COM) succeeds (case-insensitive normalization)
POST /api/admin/login with wrong password returns 401 'Invalid credentials' (not 500 or crash)
POST /api/admin/login with old credentials (admin@constructons.in / admin123) fails with 401
Database verification: admin_users collection exists with bcrypt-hashed password ($2b$12$...), email stored as lowercase
Browser flow: login with new credentials succeeds, redirects to /admin dashboard, shows 'Welcome back!' toast
Browser flow: wrong password shows 'Invalid credentials' error toast, stays on login page
Session persistence: refresh after login keeps user logged in (cookie working)
Logout button clears cookie and redirects to /admin/login
After logout, cannot access /admin (properly redirects to login)
Regression: all admin endpoints work with new auth (GET /api/packages, /api/leads, /api/quiz-submissions, /api/site-settings)
